text: Target posted a 1.5% year-over-year revenue decline to $30.45B and a 2.9% drop in transactions. Comparable sales fell 2.5% with store comps down 3.9% and digital up 1.9%. Annual sales have remained roughly flat for four years. Net income declined year over year. Shares rose following an earnings-per-share beat.

meta.note: Positive forward guidance present but excluded to preserve snapshot constraint.
